decision: Restore Chat compact/expanded surface selection; do not assume the Remote inner glass shape is shared.

observations.conclusion: Witness supplies body callback 0x4cb8cf0. Existing witness record ios-composer-inner-content-witnesses-v245.json binds its type.

Chat content calls 0x6081cb8, the same outer HeightConditionalShape<Capsule,UnevenRoundedRectangle> factory followed in Remote. Boolean argument is read from content+0x29; its semantic field is not bound yet.
Chat content also calls optional outer stroke factory 0x60819dc.
Fields are heightThreshold, ifShape, elseShape. Shape path witness 0x606707c calls 0x6066fd8.

CGRectGetHeight result is compared with stored threshold. ARM64 HI selects second shape metadata/field/witness; otherwise first. For finite nonnegative layout heights this means height greater than threshold selects elseShape; equal selects ifShape. Factory type order binds Capsule then UnevenRoundedRectangle.
Initializer 0x60810f8 reads field offset at metadata+0x9c and stores IEEE754 0x4046000000000000 = 44. This binds the default capsuleRectHeightThreshold, not the selected runtime Chat style.

Direct stores target metadata slots d8,dc,e0,e4,e8 and conditionally 10c,118. No direct write to threshold slot9c in this function. Copy/helper side effects and Chat selection still need tracing; do not claim all glass transforms preserve threshold.

host_observation.conclusion: Before repair: CALayer radius28 and clipping without explicit glass contour. After repair: compact cornerConfiguration.capsule; expansion restores saved original configuration.

MessageInputBackgroundPart body window contains multiple helper functions; UnevenRoundedRectangle import at 0x4d4b430 is in helper 0x4d4b2f0, not direct proof of the editor face shape.
Controlled local ablation confirms host contour correction, not exact official glass optical equivalence.
Expanded keyboard state inspected; return-to-compact and frame-by-frame transition not verified.
